newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sees IMF stand-by extension in October.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sees IMF stand-by extension in October.

text.p: Venezuela expects the International Monetary Fund to approve an extension of its one-year stand-by agreement in October, Central Bank President Antonio Casas Gonzalez said.
"It will be in October after the IMF meeting in Hong Kong," Casas told reporters at a ceremony to inaugurate the World Bank's new offices in Caracas.
Venezuela's 12-month stand-by agreement expired on July 11, although both the government and IMF officials have said they want to continue working together.
The stand-by extension would involve monitoring of policy and technical advice, but no cash disbursement given Venezuela's strong foreign reserves position.
